# Chunk Loader

[All items](Items.md) · [Crafting guide](Crafting-Recipes.md) · [Home](Home.md)

[How to obtain](#how-to-obtain) · [Crafting and processing](#crafting-and-processing)

<a href="Item-chunk-loader.md" title="Chunk Loader"><img src="icons/193.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Chunk Loader"></a>

Keeps its own 32 × 32 × 32 chunk loaded and active while the world runs.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Placement | Place from the hotbar |

## How to obtain

Make this item using the crafting or processing recipes below.

## Using it

Place to enable; Interact opens controls and shows chunk origin. No fuel/power required. Cover the full remote installation, including both bridge endpoints. Saves retain its enabled state. See [Bridges and chunk loaders](Bridges-and-chunk-loaders.md).
